units.source_text: 一个裸体女子忽然从昏暗的浴场里首先跑了出来，

en.t: A naked young woman suddenly ran out first from the dim bathhouse,

units.source_text: 站在更衣处伸展出去的地方，做出一副要向河岸下方跳去的姿势。

en.t: stood on the part that jutted out from the changing room, and struck a pose as if she were about to leap down toward the riverbank.

units.source_text: 她赤条条的一丝不挂，伸展双臂，喊叫着什么。

en.t: She was completely bare, wearing nothing at all, stretching out both arms and shouting something.

units.source_text: 洁白的裸体，修长的双腿，站在那里宛如一株小梧桐。

en.t: With her pure white body and long slender legs, she stood there like a young paulownia tree.

units.source_text: 我看到这幅景象，仿佛有一股清泉荡涤着我的心。

en.t: Seeing this sight, I felt as though a clear spring were washing through my heart.

units.source_text: 我深深地吁了一口气，扑哧一声笑了。

en.t: I let out a deep breath and burst into a little laugh.
She was still only a child.

units.source_text: 她发现我们，满心喜悦，就这么赤裸裸地跑到日光底下，

en.t: When she noticed us, she was so full of joy that she ran out naked into the sunlight,
rose onto her tiptoes, and stretched her body straight.
She was still only a child.

units.source_text: 我更是快活兴奋，又嘻嘻地笑了起来。

en.t: I felt even happier and more excited, and began to giggle again.

units.source_text: 脑子清晰得好像被冲刷过一样。

en.t: My mind felt clear, as if it had been washed clean.

units.source_text: 脸上始终漾出一丝丝微笑。

en.t: A faint smile lingered on my face the whole time.
